# Backup File Exposure Checker

> Enter a site URL to test eight well-known backup filenames (backup.zip, db.sql and more) for a publicly served site or database backup. Nothing uploaded to us.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/backup-file-exposure-check/)

- [Why backup files end up in web roots](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/backup-file-exposure-check/why-backup-files-end-up-in-web-roots.html)
